name: Skeleton
description: Placeholder shapes that hold the layout while content loads.

props.name: shape
props.description: Text line, rectangle or circle. Size it with className. Default block.

props.name: SkeletonGroup label
props.description: What is loading, announced once for the whole group.

a11y: Shapes are aria-hidden; SkeletonGroup is a role="status" with aria-busy and a text label.
